content_units: Anniversary Dinner Playlist Arc
A smooth 15-track set for about   90 minutes   with a clear flow: polished and intimate at the start, brighter and more rhythmic through the middle, then warm and unhurried at the end.
15-Track Dinner Sequence
1.   Sade — Kiss of Life     elegant soul opener
2.   Stan Getz & João Gilberto — Corcovado (Quiet Nights of Quiet Stars)     soft bossa, candlelit mood
3.   Norah Jones — Sunrise     gentle, affectionate, easy early-course track
4.   Al Green — Let’s Stay Together     classic romance without feeling overblown
5.   Astrud Gilberto — Agua de Beber     light lift, breezy transition
6.   Steely Dan — Peg     sleek groove, lively but still dinner-safe
7.   Bill Withers — Lovely Day     brightens the room without getting too big
8.   George Benson — Breezin’     instrumental glide for the midpoint
9.   Everything But The Girl — Each and Every One     sophisticated soft-pop pulse
10.   Boz Scaggs — Lowdown     light funk centerpiece, smooth and stylish
11.   Basia — Promises     crisp rhythm, upbeat but not distracting
12.   Anita Baker — Sweet Love     rich, intimate return after the livelier stretch
13.   Madeleine Peyroux — Dance Me to the End of Love     hushed, late-evening elegance
14.   Grover Washington Jr. feat. Bill Withers — Just the Two of Us     cozy, familiar, relaxed wind-down
15.   Ella Fitzgerald & Louis Armstrong — Dream a Little Dream of Me     soft, timeless closer
Why This Flow Works
-   Elegant start:   Tracks 1–5 keep the first 25–30 minutes refined, romantic, and low-pressure.
-   Lively middle:   Tracks 6–11 add movement and sparkle for the main course without turning the room into a dance floor.
-   Calm finish:   Tracks 12–15 settle into warm, affectionate, after-dinner energy.
Listening Notes
- All picks are generally known for   clean, dinner-safe lyrics   or instrumental ease.
- No artist repeats, so the set feels curated rather than overly fan-focused.
- The overall tone avoids breakup themes, melodrama, and overly ceremonial “first dance” energy.

Context for This Set

Estimated runtime is   about 85–95 minutes   depending on the version used for a few tracks, which fits a relaxed anniversary dinner at home well. If your meal runs shorter, stop after track 13; if it runs longer, loop tracks 8–15.
